instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

H=W=25
G=[[4]*W for _ in range(H)]
objs={
6:[(2,5),(2,6),(2,7),(3,5),(4,3),(4,4),(4,5)],
9:[(3,19),(4,20),(4,21),(4,22),(5,20),(5,22),(6,20),(6,21),(6,22),(7,19),(7,23)],
7:[(11,4),(11,8),(12,5),(12,6),(12,7),(13,5),(13,7),(14,5),(14,6),(14,7),(15,4),(15,8),(13,18),(12,18),(13,19),(13,20),(14,20),(15,20),(11,18)] ,
3:[(19,12),(20,12),(20,13),(20,14),(20,15),(21,13)]}
# Correct components: color7 has two disconnected objects, but both lower and move to top preserving original positions.
# top-half objects move down; bottom-half objects move up, align bbox to opposite edge.
for c,pts in objs.items():
    minr=min(r for r,x in pts); maxr=max(r for r,x in pts)
    # separate 7 components have same placement direction and bbox collectively would erroneously combine; apply top placement per component shapes
    if c==7:
        comps=[[(11,4),(11,8),(12,5),(12,6),(12,7),(13,5),(13,7),(14,5),(14,6),(14,7),(15,4),(15,8)],
               [(11,18),(12,18),(13,18),(13,19),(13,20),(14,20),(15,20)]]
    else: comps=[pts]
    for comp in comps:
        lo=min(r for r,x in comp); hi=max(r for r,x in comp)
        if lo < H/2: # move to bottom, align bottom edge
            delta=H-1-hi
        else: # move to top, align top edge
            delta=-lo
        for r,x in comp:
            G[r+delta][x]=c
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
